name: Touch
author: Blakeinstein
description: On-screen keyboard (wvkbd or the Virtual Keyboard plugin), tablet mode and auto-rotation, tested on Hyprland and niri, plus Hyprland-only touch gestures (hyprgrass). Writes ~/.config/hypr/dms/touch.lua, reloaded via hyprpm reload -n on every Hyprland start; the Enable button appends to binds-user.lua, and Install runs hyprpm to fetch and build hyprgrass from GitHub
